qualification.development: Same exposed100 development questions, 100 corpus identities and94 declared families. All1600 cells were preregistered new-store repeats. The same development set informed earlier experiments; no independent confirmation, confidence interval or superiority claim.
qualification.scoring: Native LongMemEval rubric and contains-yes decision with Gateway GPT-4o alias and16 output tokens. No pinned model snapshot, native10-token protocol reproduction or full-set score.
qualification.comparisons: Matched retrieval pairs use the identical reader profile and96000-byte/top100 caps. Contract pairs keep retrieval, exact question/context message bytes and model settings fixed, changing only the system answer instruction/profile identity. Outcomes are descriptive paired observations from one execution per distinct request.
qualification.answerability: Seven abstention and93 non-abstention questions, classified by selected native manifest IDs ending in _abs, matching the importer. No question text, gold labels or per-question outcomes are published.
qualification.cost: Incremental totals follow the six actual receipts across model stages and count unique physical requests once. Per-stage and arm attributed costs overlap shared judge requests and cannot be summed as new spend. All known usage; no unresolved reservations added. Provider invoice reconciliation is outside this receipt audit.
qualification.latency: Receipt wall time includes each qualification/main phase; physical and arm service-time statistics are inherited from the pinned authenticated reports, not remeasured or reauthenticated against raw captures.

dataset.name: longmemeval-s
dataset.groupingQualification: Declared grouping and exposure; no independence or freshness inferred.

scoring.judgeQualification: Gateway GPT-4o alias with native LongMemEval prompts, one user message and contains-yes grading, adapted to 16 output tokens. The requested model is not a pinned snapshot and the output cap differs from the native 10-token evaluator; not an official protocol reproduction or full-set score.
scoring.failurePolicy: Every eligible question remains in answer-score denominators. Reader failures score zero; judge failures score zero only for judge accuracy and are counted separately. Authenticated occupied attempts without a verifiable answer score zero and retain their full reservations. Never-admitted requests or unauthenticated missing evidence prevent a complete report.
scoring.evidenceQualification: Retrieval evidence is scored independently of answer success. No evidence labels means unscored, not perfect; unresolved labels remain in the denominator.
scoring.citationQualification: Not measured: the reader prompt asks for an answer without citations.

cost.qualification: Known captured usage plus full unresolved reservations, counted once per distinct occupied request in these phases. Accounted cost is conservative exposure, not a provider invoice or incremental spend for a cache-reusing invocation. Token totals and provider identities cover verified responses only; unknown usage is not zero. Reserved requests without captures do not prove dispatch. Reasoning tokens are already included in output tokens.

latency.qualification: Service time is captured once per attempted physical request through first-response body completion or failure. Reserved requests without captures are excluded from physical latency counts because dispatch is unknown. Arm values attribute each captured duration to every arm reusing it; they do not measure a cache-hit invocation. Phase wall time is receipt-reported elapsed time including queueing and concurrency.
